carried_set_rule: One tracker is judged: the fused tracker named in carried_models, with T2 bound by model_digests and the fused file tied to T2's prediction file by the prediction chain. G7 as Annex C §C.13: pass if all six coverage and three width checks pass, fail if any fails, otherwise inconclusive, with one re-score on a larger fresh seed.
change: Decision 33 (phase 6, SRD Annex C §C.13, owner decisions 2026-11-06): judge the calibrated uncertainty of the fused tracker (decision 32's -g1 IMM with the frozen T2's range fused in, k 4, every 6; stated sds under -sd) at G7 on fresh seed 215. Each tracker's 50% and 90% intervals are ± multiplier × stated sd per output (log-range, course, speed), with the multipliers fitted on seed-211 validation's G5 rows and frozen here. Nothing is trained.
rationale: Seed-211 validation (experiments/20261106-p6-research): the raw stated sds are miscalibrated for both trackers (q50 0.17-0.47 and q90 0.68-1.69, against 0.674 and 1.645 for an honest Gaussian: typical intervals too wide). Two-fold check (fit on even-indexed scenarios, judge odd): the fused tracker's coverage is within nominal ± 2 pp on all six (log-range 49.9/90.4%, course 50.8/89.8%, speed 48.5/90.2%; none wholly beyond), and its median calibrated 90% width is 0.747 [0.738, 0.755] (log-range), 0.940 [0.926, 0.954] (course) and 0.899 [0.882, 0.913] (speed) of the reference's. Carried under the validation rule (C.13). Forecast before scoring: P(G7 pass on seed 215) about 80%; weakest check speed-50 (48.5% on the odd half against a floor of 48%).
